notes.markdown:
Much wider desk and DECT phone support with a phone directory, remote management and many new phone features,
Twilio-compatible call scripts, custom AI prompts, business locations and a dispatchable location for 911 and 112 calls.

**Upgrade note:** the phone directory is now on by default. If your desk phones use it, allow 636/tcp (LDAPS) from the
phones' networks to the server.

## New

- **Every Yealink desk family and the W-series DECT kits.** Provisioning recognises all current Yealink desk phones
  (including expansion modules) and the W-series DECT bases and handsets such as the W60B, with the right time zone and
  daylight saving time and the base's web login.
- **Every current Grandstream family.** GXP, GRP, GXV, WP, the DP75x DECT bases and the HT analogue adapters are
  provisioned with time zone, language, codecs, line keys and the phone book.
- **More phone vendors.** New templates for Gigaset Pro DECT (N510, N670, N870), Cisco IP DECT 110/210, Panasonic,
  Mitel, Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise, Akuvox and Avaya J100.
- **A unique web password for every phone.** Each provisioned phone gets its own web page password instead of a shared
  default.
- **Reveal credentials.** Devices has a Reveal credentials action for the SIP account, the phone web page and the phone
  directory, protected by a fresh sign-in check.
- **Phone directory on desk phones.** A read-only company directory (LDAP over TLS) is provisioned on desk phones and
  is on by default. Work e-mail addresses stay hidden from phones unless you switch them on.
- **Remote phone management (TR-069).** A company switch (off by default) lets MonoPbx manage supporting phones
  remotely: status, parameters, reboot and resync actions, bulk actions and firmware jobs.
- **Re-enrolment after a factory reset.** A phone that was reset to factory settings waits in a re-enrolment queue so
  an administrator can hand it its configuration again.
- **Phone-screen apps.** Desk phones with an XML browser get MonoPbx apps on the phone screen, reachable from a free
  line key.
- **Voicemail key and message lamp everywhere.** The voicemail key and the message waiting lamp work on every
  supported desk phone and DECT handset, including phones that never subscribe for message alerts.
- **Texts between phones.** Desk and DECT phones can text each other, and their texts reach MonoPhone chat and SMS.
- **Do not disturb and forwarding stay in sync** between the phone and MonoPbx, and forward dial codes work from desk
  phones.
- **More desk phone features:** the connected caller's name after a transfer, distinctive ring tones, BLF pickup, a
  record key, keep-alive for phones behind NAT, intercom auto-answer, a second registrar for failover, the company
  certificate authority, and Opus as an opt-in codec.
- **Twilio-compatible call scripts.** Calls created through the Twilio-compatible API can run TwiML, including live
  updates, status callbacks, Dial actions, Say voices and remote Play media. Compiled flows keep their prompts in the
  prompt library.
- **Custom AI prompts.** Tailor the instructions for AI answers per company, feature and channel, with a preview.
- **AI answers on delivery orders.** Customers writing about a delivery order can get an AI reply in the order thread.
- **Business locations on calls.** Inbound calls are tagged with the business location of the number that was called.
- **911 and 112 calls with a dispatchable location.** Calls to 911, 112 and other public safety numbers carry the caller's registered location to trunks
  that support it, and administrators are alerted when a location is missing.
- **Call quality thresholds** are now a company setting.
- **Callback order.** Queue callbacks can call the agent first or the customer first; customer first plays a short
  announcement while the agent is connected.
- **Push-to-talk on the Keypad.** MonoPhone shows a push-to-talk pill on the Keypad for quick access to your channels.

## Improved

- **Smart callback:** a "yes" reply on WhatsApp books the callback at any step of the flow.
- **Click-to-call** keeps the audio path of your device when the call is answered.
- **Call supervision** (listen, whisper, barge) continues after a server restart.
- **CRM and Jira call logs** include a link to the recording in the console.
- **The browser extension** refreshes order cards when a shop order changes.
- **Clinic integrations** use one set of safety rules that cannot be edited away.
- **Fanvil, Snom, Poly, Cisco and Htek** provisioning was checked again, with better model detection and resync.
- **Test builds of MonoPhone** receive calls through their own push channel.
- **Voice fraud protection** now also e-mails the account owner when voice is stopped.

## Fixed

- **Provisioning behind the HTTPS front** no longer refuses phones as plain HTTP.
- **Apple Watch push-to-talk** wakes correctly for listening, and the call label no longer clips.
- **Links on the error code pages** open the right pages.

## Security

- Security improvements (medium): each phone has its own web password, phone credentials are shown only after a fresh
  sign-in check, and queue callbacks have per-number and per-hour limits with alerts.
